text: regular 2+ hour wait. no response via phone. no refund. still have not heard from them despite calling 3 times with over 20 minute hold times. pizza never delivered 4 hours later...

If you are looking for anything like Chicago pizza, this is NOT it. The pizza is no better or no worse than any other New York style pizza I have had here in Florida the last four years as I search for a taste of home. The only thing that is similar to Chicago pizza is that it is cut in the tavern style square cuts.   Ordered through Gubhub and they screwed up the order and when I called the restaurant they could care less. I'd have paid to have the correct pizza delivered and gone to Gah for the refund, but she couldn't be bothered to discuss options with me. I always check out new areas I visit for Chicago pizza. This isn't it, but there's a great one in Stuart!

I've worked in Castleton for sometime now have visited this location more than any other in the nation. Today was the third time in a year I've had to ask for refund because "someone took your order" or "we didn't see it come through". The staff communication is very unprofessional with no real sense of whose in charge. Once they begin processing the refund they realized they didn't have something I ordered which delayed the refund longer. This is the time to learn how to communicate with one another especially businesses operating during a pandemic that's simultaneously overlaps a social movement. Three strikes and I'm out. I should've learned from my previous mistakes.

Took 45 minutes just to get our appetizer. Although the food was good the service is lousy. Sat for 15 minutes and had to ask if we had a waiters. Then the waiter never asked us if we wanted anything to drink.  Also it's extremely noisy, couldn't hear my husband who was across from me over the noise.  In the future I'll only do take out
Hurry up and wait..... and wait..... and wait. The absolutely the slowest service ever. Then to add insult to injury. The food was terrible. I barely ate half and threw it out.

Great place!! Wide variety of food choices. Do not pass up the chicken & waffles at Connie's!! Best part there is a bar inside making drinks at 11am-closing. Definitely worth a try. I will be coming back. Yummy!

Nada is great! It is within walking distance of Monument Circle and the Circle Centre Mall. I love the vibe of Nada, it is both artsy and authentic and the whole space feels like a piece of eclectic artwork. While it is near busy parts of the city, the wait is never very long. We even came for a Cinco de Mayo celebration at lunch time and got a seat pretty promptly. They have really unique cocktails like the Black Rose but also have classic margaritas to enjoy. I usually get my tacos al pastor and they are delicious!

I'd leave 0 stars if I could. We waited an hour and a half with our daughter, got to the front to order our sandwiches... the worker told us we can only buy 2... there's 3 of us. When we explained that, he rudely said "Only 2 per order!". I'll never go to Popeyes again. Definitely made us instant Chik Fil A fans for life.

If you are a seafood lover this is definitely a great spot to satisfy all your seafood cravings.  We ordered take out and ordered large specials of crab legs, muscles and shrimp with cajun seasoning.  It was all very good and filling. Great idea for a gathering and a sports game too.

We have been looking forward to trying this place for a while. We just never get to Metairie that often. Decided to stop today and check it out. I am not sure we will be back. We we pulled in, the parking lot was full of cars. When we walked in, it was another matter entirely. I am not sure where all the customers were. There were on 3 tables in our section that had people. The food was really nothing to write home about. My hubby got the shrimp platter which was huge and he said it was pretty good. I got the Cajun Cannon Redfish. This came with sauteed veg and mashed potatoes. Not spectacular at all. It could have been a dish I could have eaten at 100 other restaurants. Our waiter John was nice but it was so hard to hear what he was saying because he was wearing a mask. He was trying to tell us the special but neither I nor my husband were able to understand any of it. The worst part of the whole experience is that several of the TV's were on Fox News and CNN and were covering the rioting, looting, and violence going on around the country. My husband is a Vet who suffers from PTSD. All we wanted was a nice quiet lunch. Put the games on. The news should not be on at a restaurant/ bar. You are there to enjoy yourself not have anxiety. I was very disappointed.
Excellent! Food service and great location. Crispy spring rolls, green curry beautiful flavors and the Hawaiian fried rice is wonderful. I would give more stars!

I absolutely love this place! Great options fast service delicious food. They have fresh sushi with a great presentation. They are BYOB with a bottle shop a couple of doors down. We have not had anything that we did not love.
The hibachi is a favorite of my husband and the kid's always enjoy the show. They do get packed up on the weekend nights so make a reservation for a big party. 
Carry out is also available.
Best roasted duck in Philly. My family have come here for a long time. Kids love it. Specially their sauce is the boss. Very authentic taste.

When you walk in, the smell hits you like a wall. The entire restaurant has a sewer smell. My wife and I almost left when we walked in. We decided to stay because the food was recommended. Overall, food was good, but the service was not. Our server seemed annoyed when we asked for items. Fix the smell!
Straight bomb! Nothing else needed.pizza and everything else I've tried is great love the potato salad
Everything was incredible! Great food, wine, and amazing service. Everyone couldn't have been more friendly. I can't wait to go back!

So pleased to have such a great new place open in northwest Reno. We had the crispy Brussels sprouts and bacon blue cheese burger. Everything was delicious-prepared beautifully. Good tap beer selection and service was awesome! Tucked into a little shopping center so a little hard to find but so worth the visit! We are big fans and will be regulars. Can't wait to sample more menu items.

I can't say enough good things about this place. It is one of the restaurants we always stop by when we go Clearwater Beach. Don't let the large crowd keep you from walking in for a table. It always looks super busy on the weekends but the wait goes by fairly quickly-- just order a beverage and listen to the live music on the deck with a view of the gulf. No complaints, life is good! Plus, they have a live waitlist option on Yelp now. Wish every place offered this!

The food is spectacular. Over the last few visits we've had the crab cakes and seafood fried rice-- holy goodness! Must try. And the Korean BBQ ribs, Thai peanut pasta, meatloaf and sesame chicken are also delicious. Dessert is a must. They change up the offerings regularly. The fish is always fresh and they offer a local catch. The staff is friendly mood even with all of the tables full and business hopping. Job well done here!

I've been here plenty of times and always had a good experience until recently. 
I took my sister who was visiting me. And the service was terrible and nothing like it usually is. 
My table was sticky especially with this corona virus I was not pleased at how the servers were cleaning. 
All the employees looked like they hated their lives. 
Getting looked at up and down constantly as well.

To top it off, the milk was spoiled and the waitress tried saying it wasn't. I've had the milk before it was clearly spoiled, discolored, chunky, and smelled AWFUL. And had the nerve to say "oh someone tried it in the back it's not spoiled" 
Highly doubt it. 

Food is good, and it's a cute vibe. But that day ruined my opinion of the place.
A corner of Mexico in the US. Tortillas are freshly made, the salsas are outstanding, the meat is super tender and flavorful! If you are in Philly, you have to try this place!

Food is so flavorful and delicious. Portion sizes are huge. Could not finish half of my food because I was so full. I ordered the brisket nachos and they were layered to perfection. Their ribs are the best. You can tell they have been slow cooking forever. The chicken is so moist and delicious as well. A must try!
The best Cheese Steak/Chicken Cheese Steak outside of South Philadelphia.  Even order the bread daily from the Philly Bakery.  Also great Subs make the Philly way.
The Italian food is authentic, made to order and amazing. The owner, Luca, offers a warm, inviting and family friendly atmosphere.

Wings are amazing !! Get the Guy seasoning it's hands down one of the best wings I've had in a while . Perfectly cooked ! The Bilmar fish sandwich was also really good ! Plus $3 bud light & yuengling plus they have deals for food for each day of the week ! They have foozeball darts ,pinball an more
Overall one of the nicer fuzzy locations.  However, St. Louis is struggling getting nice ones.  Out west all newer and way nicer. Food was fast

New locations are popping up all over the city. I love this place. I love the mimosas. I love the bacon and perfect pancakes. One of the few places in Indianapolis that offers grits. When I need to eat, I need to be satisfied, and I need comfort food this is where I go.

I ordered the chipotle turkey club only to find out they were out of turkey. They substituted chicken and I was a bit skeptical but wow, it was so good! The bread was fresh and the chicken was cooked perfectly.  The combo of flavors was so excellent!

I was up here yesterday and there was a guy named Alex who was a worker and he kept kissing and all up on another worker lady I forgot her name but she had long black hair and a weird voice so I guess they forgot a pandemic is going on because you should have to wear a mask being around food and you shouldn't be doing all that extra shit while at work save that for once you get off and I ordered a spicy deluxe with bacon and there was no bacon  and it was cold when I went to eat it. Never will I eat at this chick fil a again.

Reno's Best Asian Restaurant!!!

This place rocks if your seeking authentic Taiwanese food.  
Staff and owner are friendly not intimidating they speak  English.  Food is fresh and fairly priced.

I visited Sophia's a couple days ago with five other friends. This was our 2nd lunch outing to Sophia's and both visits were wonderful! Half of us enjoyed the BFG and the other half cleaned their plates of lemon rice bowls with a myriad of add-ons.

One of our guests was late, but our awesome server asked the kitchen to move up her order so her food wouldn't be too far behind the rest of the table. That's the kind of service that will bring us back! (The delicious food doesn't hurt, either )

They have very high quality homemade ice cream with tons of flavors. I really liked the blueberry cornbread flavor. The shop is near Broadway so you can get ice cream before bar hopping, super convenient location!
Delicious gem in Media that we stumbled upon. Definitely will be going back frequently. Had short rib paperdelle, crab cakes, and creme brûlée cheesecake. All was amazing!

::sigh:: I LOVE me some Mission BBQ.  There's something about it that just makes my heart and belly so darn happy.

It's the menu, of course, that offers up allllll the sandwiches, a whole bunch of sides to satisfy just about any craving you you have.  Pulled pork, brisket, chicken.  And those sides - a perfect compliment to any bbq sandwich.  My personal favs are the mac & cheese and the baked beans.  So so good. 

And then there's the option of 'making it a combo.'  Yes. please!  For only $4.75?  Of course I'd like to add two sides and a drink to my sandwich.  My drink of choice: the sweet tea!  Sweet and unlimited.  

And that 6-pack of sauces located at each table.  I've tried them all before and I'd try them all again and again.  Even though I've got a favorite - the smokey mountain - I love sampling each one whenever I go to Mission.

Beyond the food and drink - the restaurant itself is clean, staffed w/ super friendly folks and decorated w/ photos & misc items celebrating local schools plus the armed forces.  How can you not enjoy a meal at Mission BBQ!?!
Love the place...food was good, prices reasonable and nice people...away from the usual tourist traps...would definitely go back again..
great food, awesome dancing, and we love the staff!

Man, what's with the good reviews? Seriously. I'm flabbergasted at the amount of hype this place has. I came on an empty Tuesday, we were the only ones (my bf and I) and the food quality was so incredibly disgusting. Meats were over cooked, fish has the bones in them, and the monkey bread... wow that monkey bread was disgusting. Highly overcooked and microwaved. Not fresh or "doughy" at all. 5 stars for the servers but dang! Tampa.. please do better, these reviews are always so off.

My husband and I have tried many bagel places across south jersey and this place has some of the best bagels in the area. The honey wheat bagel has a fragrant honey scent but it's not too sweet. As for the wheat bagel, I really like how there are oats on the top since it provides a nice contrast to the bagel itself. The bagels have a nice chew and not too much of a crust. 

As for their breakfast sandwiches, the portions are big and hardy. At least for the egg and cheese sandwiches, there is a great balance between the creamy cheese and salty sausage.

I'll definitely be back when I want a great, local bagel breakfast sandwich.

We went here for my son's 9th birthday, because he has been asking to go here but the service was so bad, First of all we had to get our own napkins and our own silverware. Then I had to let someone know that we are ready take are order. My niece ordered  shrimp cocktail it had no flavor she had to add ketchup to it and salt. My son got king crab legs they were extremely salty. My youngest son got oysters and they taste like they weren't fresh. Me and my husband shared the $60 plate of variety of seafood, Will even that was extremely salty. Then when it came to the bill they messed up on are payments, They ring the cards up under different bills. So it was either the food had no flavor or the food was extremely salty, The Customer service flat out sucked. When I have to ask for plates, silverware and napkins to feed my family with, that's sad I would never go here again.

Food was well prepared and well served. The HUGE turnoff was the extra cologned, fabrize soaked waiter that took our breath away every time he passed our table. Managers should clue their staff in about this.
Puhleez! Felt like I was at a coin laundromat.

Passed by Shake Shake and my toddler had a yearning for their fries (it's been 3 months). I walked up to the counter, was the only one there on Saturday at 12.45pm, paid and waited patiently for the fries to be prepared. 

10 mins later, I see an employee put a box of fries in a bag and the counter person handed it to me. I presumed it was freshly made, after all took nearly a quarter hour to prepare right?

No, it was ice cold. I supposed the employees had other things to do at the time since there was literally no other order, not even another bag at the counter. 

My poor little guy; mommy could have made fresher fries from frozen thrown in my air fryer during that time.
Way overpriced and hit or miss service! Over $45 for 2 people with a tip, the food is just OK. Nope, we won't be back! There are better options out there.

Went with a few friends the weekend before it opened for free entrees and a drink on the house. It was a practice session before opening night. I enjoyed dining at the King of Prussia location so I had really high hopes for the Willow Grove location. We first placed drink orders. I got the rose refresher which was absolutely delicious. If you don't mind sweet drinks then I highly recommend it! We were allowed one appetizer so we got the poke nachos. Again, very good! The flavors were phenomenal and ingredients tasted fresh. Unfortunately they were out of a lot of main dishes because it was only a test run. They ensured this won't happen once the doors were open for real. I decided to order the chicken enchilada stack and I'm  happy I did! The flavors were so good and each bite just melted in my mouth. YUM! I also added the photos of my friends meals as well which they all enjoyed and were very impressed with. Even though it was a test run, the service was still very quick. All team members did a phenomenal job. I HIGHLY recommend giving yard house a try. You will not regret it!

Amazing in every aspect and each time I've been there. I have eaten here three times and have introduced one of my most reliable food cretics. The atmosphere, the presentation, and the flavors are spot on perfect. I have eaten at many Michelin restaurants around the world and this little gem in South Tampa Fl is as good. As for the bad reviews: REALLY?? Try to remember that this is a fine dinning experience at a reasonable price. 72oz free soda refills are not what they are all about.
Literally didn't want to go here because of the Yelp rating but it was sooooo good! Wings were awesome and the food and service was superb!
Love this place! Never had a bad meal or bad service here. The steaks, seafood, and risotto are all great!

Busy place with good Mexican food in downtown Tampa. Not the best I've ever had, but a solid option if that's what you're looking for. Pretty loud inside, but the servers did a good job of getting to everyone.

Adorable interior with a very cosy atmosphere. It's been difficult to find really good Japanese food in Indianapolis, but I got exactly what I was looking for here! Perfectly salted edamame, hot green tea, and delicious tempura udon. All of the food came out in a very timely manner and everyone was so nice. I went by myself but this is also a very cute place for a date!

From the outside, it looks old, dated and kooky with the old jet skis and dummies... And that's what kept me away. A long wait elsewhere finally convinced me to walk inside. 

Inside is nothing like the exterior. It's actually nice, modern and clean. It's not kooky or kitschy. 

And the best part - the food is really good!

Well-prepared, fresh fish. Exactly what you should expect from a fish camp, right?

I'm a fan. Get rid of the kitsch : )
This place is classic. Best burger in town if not the state. But beware- children are not allowed.

i got the hot pot and it was majorly delicious! the broth was super tasty and the ingredients were great! there was also things like sushi, fried rice, egg rolls, etc. available on the buffet! the staff kept my drink above half and kept the broth full the whole time! very friendly! it's also clean and well decorated inside! 10/10 would recommend lol

Gorgeous inside and out! We stopped by the week before Christmas and the decorations were stunning. Excited to try the cakes we purchased. Open to eat there too, but we didn't have reservations and there was a 4 hour wait.

This was my first visit to the conch republic. I was not disappointed. They have a wide range of seaford dishes along with good non seaford meals. The shrimp 3 ways was the best. The mahi sandwich was a winner.
Excellent food.  Great music and great atmosphere! Perfect place to hang out with friends.

Upside: The food was great except really salty mashed potatoes but the rest of our food made up for that. The downside: We had a large group and our server was less than prepared and did not seem to know how to handle such. I dont think he was trained for group service. He was less than friendly for someone on customer service. There things forgotten, plates mixed, and refills nonexistent if not asked for but all in all we had a good time

By far the best breakfast place I've been to in a long time. The food is consistently amazing and homestyle. Cute little mom and pop place that feels right at home and is always busy. Love love love it!

Delicious pizza, bread sticks, and dessert sticks. Great for a quick lunch or dinner. Service was phenomenal. Will be back.
Don't forget to download the app for pre-ordering and points.

The toasted ravioli makes this worth a stop. The meat was wonderful- perfectly seasoned. The crunch on the ravioli was also pretty fantastic. I was disappointed they didn't have their lunch menu available before 3pm, as I didn't have dinner menu hunger. The service was a little weird, but we were only there to try the toasted ravioli so whatever. They didn't have taps, but my husband picked a good double IPA.

Came for breakfast and I really enjoyed it.  Got the regular eggs benedict with tator tots (nice option instead of home fries).  

Could have used a little more seasoning but thats all personal preference and nothing a little black pepper couldn't resolve.  

Service was friendly and they were nice to my puppy. 

And since they are on Market Street, it was a nice touch to have the mini walls blocking (minimal Sunday morning) traffic.  

Yeah, I'll go back.
Best local restaurant for breakfast food! I get the Bacon, Egg & Cheese almost daily when I'm in town.

I've been at this location twice after being referred 
By a facebook fan you can get a meat 2 vegies and desert for 12.30 plus tip I save 5.00 a plate from my 
Other meat and 2 place and the food is great I have enough to eat the remainder in the evening which 
During these times are a great value also the staff 
Are very nice and professional they even have a club 
Buy 20 get one free coupon card in which I've never seen in the restaurant world

I was not impressed though I don't seem to be the norm. The restaurant is visually pleasant but the room was very noisy.  It has a big happy hour crowd and the noise spills into the dining room.  I made a poor choice in my dinner.  The spicy tofu was not to my liking.  The tofu was way over fried, tasteless and leathery.  My dinner companions were much happier with their salmon and Mahi tacos.  We enjoyed an unbothered leisurely dinner which was great since we had a lot of catching up to do but I would have appreciated a refill of water.  I certainly have not written Harvest off! I'll give it another try and order something different next time.

Very good food. Special soup is amazing, gourmet food, beautiful and delicious 
Family restaurant, owner and son cooking the best food ever
Server is so articulate and knowledgeable, best place just off the state street, fast service and open later than most of other places

This will probably shock you, but found this place on Yelp.... fast casual dining. Pretty decent beer selection with Shiner and Revision beers. Came on a Saturday and had a small line but it moved quickly. Ordered brisket plate with hot bbq sauce. The brisket was absolutely delicious the best I've had outside of Texas. Hot bbq sauce is great and has a pretty good amount of heat. For sides I had Spanish rice and pinto beans which were fine, but not at the level of the brisket. Will be back to try more of their menu. Looks like they do house made sausages/ links.

As a Ohio native new to Tennessee, Southern BBQ is magical.  I ordered a Full Rack of Ribs on Friday and they were just fall off the bone smoked perfection.  Taste, texture, temperature, it was spot on.  All too often are ribs back home just bathed in sauce.  These ribs weren't even messy. It's like the rack of ribs you wish you'd get everywhere. Won't be my last time there.

We stumbled across this listing and I was really craving Malaysian food. While it's good and I'm sure a large % of the people nearby have never tried it before, it didn't hit it's mark with me. It was more of just an extra spicy version of regular chinese food with sushi...which always throws me off but I guess Americans love to eat sushi at Asian restaurants regardless of what type of cuisine it is... 

The service was OK we did come in about 45 minutes before they were closing so there were already making their dinners and eating it at the booth nearby. Glad we got a lot of the dishes and tried them coz I don't think we'll be making the trek back out that way to try it again.

First things first, this place is extremely beautifully decorated and cute. It is clean and has a very modern yet chic Parisian style going on. My friend and I loved it and visited for brunch. The food was quite good. I will say the avocado toast is not that filling and it's not the best I've had. The banana bread was delicious tho! My friend also enjoyed her Madame Croquet. It's an average priced restaurant, around $14-17 per entree. We will definitely come back to check out the bar soon.
Really great spot. Never had bubble tea prior to trying this place and fell in love instantly! I had a pineapple tea which was amazing with honey boba. YUMMY. can't wait to go again

Good food. Moderately priced. Good service too. We are regulars there now. Good variety of food. Best chicken wings around. Those are kind of pricey now. Like everyplace else now.
But, still worth the price. We don't mind paying for good food. And there's is consistently good. No hit and miss.
Came from out of town and found this gem on yelp.  Extremely friendly.  Amazing food.  Great coffee.  Thx again Kaffe!

Brought my daughter in to shop for a new swimsuit as she is in between shopping in girls and transitioning into ladies clothes apparently you cannot try on swimwear so we will go else where. It seems every time I visit Walmart there is a new reason as to why I should shop at meijer instead. 

Not worth shopping at Walmart anymore. I'd rather spend more for a welcoming experience

My husband and I have waited for Magnificent Garden for two years. And after reading the reviews and stuff we're kind of in a bind. But after much speculation between me and my husband, we have decided to try Magnificent Garden. 

We got inside and saw the place was really spacious. We got seated right away and our waitress (black hair with bangs and black glasses) was very nice and gave us a few minutes to decide what my husband and I wanted. My husband and I love Korean food and we cook korean dishes almost twice a week. 

My husband got the Pop chicken which he liked a lot and I got the Bulgogi Stew. I liked it too. The reviews that says it's not a lot of food for one order is not right. We are both very full with our orders. I even had to bring home the rest of my stew. 

We also ordered Hotteok and they gave us each a scoop of ice cream :)

I liked coming in to Magnificent Garden and one of the owners (she's in a wheelchair) came over our table and asked how we are doing. She's very friendly. Told her we're going to SoKor soon and she gave us some tips and advice :)

My only thing is that some of the price in the menu they have inside the restaurant is different than the one online. So if you look at their menu online, some of the price will be about a dollar or two dollars more.

Also it's just too bad they don't offer eat all you can like some of the KBBQs I've been to in the east coast and west coast. 


All in all, I really liked going in and will come back soon. :D

Excellent meal and service! Our server Joseph did a great job at explaining the specials and answered our questions. I had the Bronzino Oscar style and my husband had the filet with scallops. The dinner roles made by a pastry chef were delicious. Lemon cake with cream cheese icing was the prefect end to the meal.  Pricey but worth it! I would go again!
This place was absolutely wonderful and I had a Cuban style cheeseburger and chips and the salsa was fantastic! Will be coming here again

I'm from Los Angeles , was around , check the reviews before dining there.
The service was bad and the food even worst .
Not sure why that place has good reviews

Generally good food, moderate wait. Forgot to put avocado on my order but provided a side. Not really a full service restaurant. They drop your food off and that's it. We placed an order for additional food and it took a long time to get it. They dropped it off and said, oh we lost your order for a bit but it probably just sat in the window, because the bread was soggy. Hopefully this was an off day but the service could be better.

Excelente servicio y atenciones.  La comida estaba exquisita y el ambiente espectacular. Ordenamos churrasco con camarones, pechuga rellena de brócoli y queso con camarones y pechuga a la plancha con tostones.  Volvería nuevamente.

Sub par pretzel shop. Been multiple times thinking it was just the time of day, each time we have received cold dry pretzels. Ordered nuggets, pizza pretzel, hot dog, and bratwurst. The pizza one was rock hard and hallow, the hot dog and brat were hard and cold. I'm open to trying them again since it's so much closer then others, but if you have the time there are much better options.

So haven't been into the restaurant since the pandemic but I have been ordering regularly through door dash and have had a variety of their food. Rexy's as per usual is always absolutely fantastic 5 stars all around!  Their lemon cake? Decadent, light and airy sponge cake with a smooth and rich lemon cream icing is perfectly  balanced. Their lasagna is rich and robust with ricotta and their red wine based meat sauce. Layered and cooked to perfection with pasta a nice Al dente. Mamas meatballs never fail to please though covered in ricotta and the perfect blend of meats and balancing the fat ratio. These meatballs are an experience as they melt in your mouth not greasy, not dry, but pure perfection. Only commentary is you have to ask for more sauce because it's so amazing and you need it for their bread they send. I was skeptical about the chicken parm meatballs but Rexy's came through there as well the ground chicken really shines in their blend as they elevate it without losing quality in the fryer. Trying to stay away from meat try the Lobster Ravioli if you are okay with seafood or their cheese ravioli if not. The lobster ravioli comes in a brandy cream sauce that knocks your socks off. A true epicurean delight in the South Jersey area. You can't really go wrong here their burgers even 30 minute travel time stay warm and juicy when they arrive.

The chicken was very juicy and crunchy and flavorful. We ordered the spicy hot, soy, and Cajun. The side order of cold slaw was tasty, but very small portion for the cost. The chicken is a little pricey, but hey, you gotta pay a little more to get anything worth eating these days.

We found this restaurant while looking for a place on YELP. We went and had a fantastic meal. The service was attentive and hospitable, the food was outstanding and the atmosphere was formal, but relaxed. You couldn't go wrong with their food or drink selection. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for an excellent dinning experience.
If I could have licked the plate I would have!!!  So delicious!!  Tiger shrimp Tamal. This place is flavor town!!!!

Eating all over Nola I consulted the Best New list around town and chose Palm & Pine. As a traveling foodie, this was easily the best meal I've had in a year around the nation. Flavor, amazing combinations of spice, protein, vegetables combined with sauces you could not imagine. I started with the 2 of cups Jalepeno spirit with the goat curry app. Followed by the oaxacan duck mole with a Peking duck tamale. The house blessed us with their signature brussel sprouts and some of their amazing sorbet. My colleague had the turkey neck gumbo and the Texas bbq shrimp. The service was patient and recommended wisely and the chef/owner came over to advise on other Nola food joints to visit. First class all the way around. Bravo.

The hubs and I went for an early New Years Eve dinner last night.   We splurged.  I had the $30 Peppered Filet Mignon with Caesar salad and twice baked potato.  This was without a doubt the best steak I've ever eaten.  The filet was melt in the mouth tender, perfectly seasoned and the temperature was spot on medium rare.  The sauce was so tasty.   My husband had the $29 ribeye with garden salad and the same potato.  He said his was delicious also.  This was the first time we've been there since they remodeled after the fire.   They staff was wearing masks and everyone was seated to provide social distancing.  The only drawback was we were seated on the first floor.  I would have preferred the upstairs with a view.  My fault I didn't request.  Highly recommend.   I gave my compliments to the chef.  Our waitress was very sweet.

This place is popular because Luke Bryan owns it which is why I went in to begin with, I was sadly disappointed. We sat down at a dirty table since no others were available and had a long wait before we flagged down a server to take our order. When we asked him to clean the table he wiped it down with his hand, service was slow, sushi was decent but nothing special. The music was great though! It's a good place to stop by and listen to music and have a drink but wouldn't be back to eat.

Not worth it. I've paid way less for a far better experience at restaurants like this In other cities. Food was okay but service was crappy. Unenthusiastic, to call a meal "The Ultimate Experience" and not offer any is mehhh. Covid kind of killed it for us. You can't even go to the salad bar and they still charge you the same. They brought a few items around but we're just never going back. My favorite brand is Texas de Brazil. This is a BIG NO from me. Dry personalities, no way to really notify the meat servers aside from waving them down. Just meh.

I have ate here numerous times and the food is 5 stars all the way. What takes away from the dining experience is the customer service. During peak times expect to wait and if you are a large group be sure to add 30 to 60 minutes to whatever estimate you are given. If your experience is in any way ruined, expect to do a fair amount of haggling to get them to provide a credit or compensate you (if they do at all).

Had a wonderful time with friends for a birthday. We ordered several dishes that were great to share, and the menu has so many options! The owner/manager was very kind and came over to ask us how everything was. When he learned it was our friends birthday he treated us to complimentary dessert! Waiter was very attentive and sweet as well. Everyone was wearing a mask which we appreciated, and seating was spaced well for a safe distance. Outdoor seating seemed to be available as well. Would highly recommend!
SOOOooo good. The Tom Kha Gai soup and Chicken Pad Thai are top notch. I'm so glad we ran across this restaurant. Very friendly people and super clean place. Will be coming back for sure.
This place is amazing for brunch. Their burger and warm rice bowl were delicious!!! Super quaint, nice server, and outdoor seating with heateds
Went for lunch was not happy with the selection of soft drinks.  Paid for a drink come to find out they are out of Coke, lemonade, ice tea after paying $16 for my lunch I expect a drive nk.

Food was good no issues with that just feel alittle ripped off. We Ordered 2 entrees and an appetizer mind you this was around 11 am. We both asked for the lunch portion and on weekends they said they won't serve the lunch portion. No biggie so the entree was around 15.50 lunch price was around 9.50 then they ask what kind of rice we want, we both chose fried rice, so we eat out lunch and get our bill, it's $50 I thought maybe there was something wrong, I check the bill and they charged both of us $3 EACH for fried rice so $6 dollars total for rice. Never once said fried rice is extra. Nobody is trying to spend 50$ on a quick lunch. In my opinion food was good but very overpriced.
I'm so excited Rex is in st Pete!!! Best sushi ever! I'm so happy I found them again!

I came here before the shut down and WOW it was amazing. I was really looking forward to coming back now that they were reopened. Sadly we were quite disappointed. We waited for 1.5 hours for a table, okay it's Saturday night and no reservations and since it was so good we thought well  worth the wait. We were finally seated and sadly no one came to our table besides the person who brought the chips who said they couldn't take our order. Well no one came back for 20 minutes. I asked what kind of margaritas they had, he said raspberry and peach. I asked because there was no drink menu and there was only one margarita listed in the entire menu their house margarita. Since he didn't know nor did he want to find out the other types that they served I went with the house, it wasn't bad but it was heavy on the sour mix. I ordered the gourmet agave fried chicken tacos. While the menu describes them as sweet, they had buffalo sauce tomatoes and was not tasty at all. My dinner partner ordered fajitas with chicken and carne asada( not the NY strip) He got a hot bowl of guacamole, pick chicken and NY strip, there was so much juice in the bottom of the bowl it was like soup. I was extremely disappointed and we won't be back. There are o many choices for eco and food in Reno why go to a place that doesn't want your business and doesn't care what they serve you???

There was a roach crawling around on the salad bar. Manager said they'd already had the exterminator out there at least once. Restrooms are filthy floors are covered with food and crumbs (no wonder there was a roach). Food is not up to par they served raw chicken.

My experience at the red hen was amazing.. and it was all thanks to my excellent waiter-- Justin! He was so knowledgeable about the menu and had such an upbeat personality. You can tell he truly engaged with all of his customers.. which is service that trendy restaurants tend to lack. The food was great and came out fast. The reason why I gave it 4 stars was the horrible music selection. The vibe went from upbeat pop to depressing early 2000's Nickelback... all in all... hand Tommy the host the aux cord.

I brought my husband here for the first time last night and he enjoyed himself beyond words and asked me why we haven't been here before. I've been here many times with friends and with other yelpers this is solid service great food always to pick up some homemade tofu. My son and I both opted for theBan mi sandwich the traditional with the head cheese and the pate on the crispiest softest and crunchiest bread with fresh pickled vegetables along side. We both of course opted for fruit slush- me pineapple and him passion fruit. You must try and order of spring rolls not all of them are cooked some of them are cold with the cellophane wrap and fresh tofu and shrimp. If anything needs a little extra space on the table are two containers one fairly spicy and the other volcanic spicy. Service always spot on quick efficient and clean. Do yourself a favor stop in they're open seven days a week.
Sit outside if you want the true Tampa experience Or inside in the air conditioning plenty of seating all around never had to wait more than a few minutes.

They have really made the most out of the unfortunate covid shutdowns! The sashimi was amazing and the fried cauliflower was amazing ! Fast service! Great food , parking can be a bit tougher but over all great experience

Special trip from Sarasota. I requested we go, my guests were agreeable but not thrilled due to previous experience. Music obnoxiously loud so that conversation could not take place comfortably. No high chairs, no take outs, due to "being too busy". Its Ramen get over yourself.  Second and last time going. Haven't quite figured out what demographic they are appealing to but whoever it is lets hope they can afford $13 ramen. Broth is very good, it earns 2 stars!!

Was in the area and as looking at Yelp for a pink go. The reviews were good and it didn't   We were seated quickly safely socially distant. The frozen keep it peachy is delicious. Th impossible meatballs tastes very close to the regular meatballs. I ordered the salmon or entree. Great play on sweet and savory. Good vibes and service.
great outdoor ambiance and amazing grilled cheese  we split a very reasonably priced bottle of local rosé which was very yummy. dying to go back here for some beers!

Nadine's cakes are amazing! I've had them a few years for my birthday as well as other people's. 

They're very delicious and worth every penny.

Wow, OK, I mean, what a little surprise at the end of Mass Ave! We found it accidentally, having driven down to Love Handle ahead of our flight, only to find they're still not offering their full menu, but basically just takeout. What to Cockadoodledoo now!? Well, I'll tell you. We ran right into the Rooster across the street, and I'm so glad we did because the eggs were FRESH - according to Future Husband. We wondered if they kept a secret farm in the kitchen, because everything really tastes so fresh here.

Waitress took a very long time to approach the table and forgot what she was doing a few times, but admitted to being new, and that's ok. I know she'll get the hang of it. I can feel it. She also did make sure we got out on time to catch our flight. What a gem.

Rather than coffee, I chose a CBD soda figuring it was either the best choice pre-flight or worst choice. It didn't affect me on the flight at all but I WAS basically falling asleep walking through security. Made me feel very lethargic. Love that they offer these though. Future Husband ordered a Sprite, but everywhere offers those.

Waitress recommended I get the salad with the hummus in it after I asked her if I should get that or the avocado toast and she mindlessly chose one because, again, she's never eaten this food and she's new. I added Turkey to the salad because ya girl always needs some protein. Even though this is the freshly shaved, thick Turkey, and I usually prefer the thin deli stuff, I really didn
Love Moe's OG bbq, it's right off Main Street in downtown franklin. You dont have to go far to have great food.  Eat wings in town hands down. Brews on tap fast and friendly service.

This place is the worst. Got the wrong pizzas delivered, it was a mess to say the least. They did not even offer to give a refund which is absolutely terrible. Avoid this papa john's location at all costs!!! I'm never ordering from this place again. I would give 0 stars if i could.

We came on a monday at about 1pm. So, it's not during normal primetime hours where anything special is going on. My date had the shrimp & grits and I had the meatloaf patty melt. We each had a cocktail. The food tastes good and the drinks were strong. But the portions and prices didn't match. I'd come back during brunch or late night for those prices, but not for lunch.

I can't tell you how many times I have passed by this place.  I decide to stop for dinner. It was great. The food and drinks were delicious and the service was nice.  There are so many items on the menu I would like to try. So I will be back!

I really wanted to love this place. I love seafood.  I totally understand new business opening hiccups, however being a foodie I can tell this pace won't last a year. It's open however no liquor license. A liquor license is what would be needed to keep them open with subpar food and insane prices. I spent $90 with ONE $3 beer and seafood for two. 

Oysters were super fishy and we couldn't finish them. That never happens

The boil bag is a pain in the a$$ and they should think of another way to serve the seafood. No one cares about it being "hot". Seafood is typically room temp. 

Waitress was nice, she really tried a lot but was clueless. 

Prices aren't listed even ok menus for a reason. The reason is they are insane thinking they charge what they do for seafood that doesn't taste good. 

Bathrooms already had no soap and doors are sticky. Not sure why when it just opened.
Last I ate there 2 days ago the asparagus / mushroom w/ Salmon wasn't v good . Service is excellent BUT the salmon wasn't v fresh and little asparagus and mushrooms.. adequate but that's it

Great service! I got the famous burger and I can see why it's famous. I usually don't finish my burgers but this one I wanted more. It was so tasty. I also tried the Blondie for a dessert. I am going to mark this place and come visit next time I'm in the area.
Great coffee, really good omelette for takeout.  Would love to come back to eat in soon.

Absolutely abysmal dining experience. Rock bottom used to be my favorite restaurant on Broadway. Been coming here since before I was a Nashville resident, have taken business associates here while they're in town, and have recommend it to our Air BnB guests as a great hang with stellar food.  Never again. You might think that a restaurant that is serving at half capacity would be overly attentive to its patrons, but our server had to be flagged down multiple times by all the tables in his section. He was never attentive to the needs of his guests, and after waiting an hour for our food (from a menu that has totally changed since our last visit,) and speaking to a manager, the food was brought to us under-prepared and cold. The manager brought me another plate as a replacement but it was t what I ordered. We are a large squad with six small children under 12, and I realize that Rock Bottom is not entirely a family-oriented establishment, but you'd think they could cater to us the way they always have in the past. We weren't looking for anything but a great dinner after a busy night performing, but my wife's Sirloin was so bad she didn't take another bite after two attempts. Such a bummer this happened because I've always loved this place because it was always so predictably excellent.  Manager offered a small discount or ice cream for my kids, but the damage had been done. Won't be returning, won't be recommending any longer.

I have a great experience here every time I am in the area. Ordered food for the family this morning, they took my order got me rolling and out efficiently. The food is hot I ate a corner of my fish just to taste and it was delicious! We have shrimp and chicken also and I know it will be just as great as always. I recommend mother's fish all the time to my out of town family and anyone in st. Louis when they are looking for good food. Great service, great people and great food everytime.... You can't beat that. Will definitely be back.

Older lady at the register has such a bad attitude. She shouldn't be taking order if she doesn't understand English.  We order 2 chicken sandwich but she gave us 1 pork sandwich (we do not eat pork) gave us wrong food on top of that she argued back saying mean things. The guy in the kitchen looked mad filthy disgusting. I don't mean to judge but i wouldn't want someone  dressing dirty to cook my food and pay for it. I know the owner for years he knows how to keep his guest happy. Also The older lady wasn't wearing mask. Never going back again.
Good spot to grab a quick lunch on mass ave. Your standard Greek menu with gyros and platters. Hummus was very good as well.

Twice I've been to this location and it is very good. I'm sure most people come for the empanadas but I'm a big fan of the "Chef Salad". It comes with a small piece of lightly pressed Cuban bread. The small salad is plenty to satisfy your hunger. It's loaded with parmesan cheese, ham,  salami, provolone and olives. Today it was very heavy on the olives so next time I may ask for light. If you're familiar with the Colombia's 1905 salad this is better. Same concept just more of the good stuff. 

I  tried the beef and cheese empanada last time and it was good. Not the best I've had, but still tasty. They do offer a variety of empanadas. Beef, chicken, spinach artichoke to name a few. I'll have to try those in the future to compare. 

Lunch time gets crazy busy and parking can be cumbersome so don't go if you're in a rush. It's a spot work checking out for sure

I did not enjoy the visit! The fried seafood was fried too long. The service was not very good at all. We sat outside on the patio, I flagged down a waitress and asked for some ketchup. She went over to a table that hadn't been cleaned yet and brought the bottle that the previous patron had used. It had been sitting in the hot sun and when I went to open the bottle, it exploded all over me and the table. I called across to a waitress for some napkins and some clean towels. She brought me 2 paper napkins and didn't even offer any concern. They didn't offer any apology or anything.
We will NOT return!
Chuck Day

Everything is soooooo good here! PERIOD. I was so impressed by the quality of the food as well as the server's knowledge and recommendations. Her descriptions were very convincing!

Charbroiled oysters: we discovered charboiled oysters in New Orleans and we were so happy they were here...just as good and so much flavor! They come in 6 and it was a party in my mouth!! Cheese, herbs, and perfect amounts of garlic. I prefer this over raw oysters. It will not disappoint!  

50/50 clam chowder: half original/ half tomato based. Perfectly flavorful and hearty...a nice blend. Not too thin and not too thick. 

Sand dabs: crispy on the outside and cooked nicely on the inside.. butter, lemon, and capers really complimented nicely, Paired well with the corn and cilantro side dish, as it was very refreshing. Sauteed spinach was light and also made for a good choice with the heaviness of the fried fish. 

Lobster roll: nice big chunks of lobster..it was very fresh and the bread was buttery while slightly crispy. Very good. 

My favorite was the charbroiled oysters but everything was so good! I haven't been to a restaurant that had all very good dishes in awhile...with good quality ingredients as well as seasoned to perfection. I would love to come back! 

Menu on yelp is different and limited from at restaurant menus due to covid. Outdoor seating spaced apart during covid available. I saw them wiping down tables after every customer.

I've heard of Duck Donuts for about a year now, I've never stopped in the store. If you're a donut aficionado, then this place is for you. Not only are all of the cake donuts made fresh, there's virtually an unlimited number of combinations of different glazes and toppings you can put on your donut. If you're not sure as to what combination of glazes or toppings to select for your donut, there are already pre-made donut combinations that can be made fresh for you. You can find vanilla cake donuts here seven days a week, but on Saturday and Sunday, they offer chocolate cake donuts as well. 

I ordered the Double Donut Combo with a hot coffee, vanilla cake donut with maple glaze, crumbled bacon and a salted caramel drizzle and a chocolate cake donut with peanut butter glaze and fudge drizzle on top. The coffee was very fresh tasting and delicious, but it was more luke warm than hot despite drinking my coffee black. The vanilla cake donut reminded me of a delicious pancake breakfast with a side of bacon and the chocolate cake donut had a delicious peanut butter taste with just the right amount of chocolate between the chocolate cake donut and fudge drizzle. The only thing that would have made the donuts perfect was that the chocolate cake donut was considerably smaller than the vanilla cake donut. 

All in all, I will definitely be back again to try new donut combinations despite the couple of areas that needed to be improved.
Music was good and the staff was really good till checkout time. Really need to pay close attention to you bill when you checkout
Valentines dinner tonight they did a wonderful presentation. The food was excellent and the table so well spaced out. What a special meal. If you have not tried this restaurant it's a must
Fresh ingredients each and every time. My go to order is one of the great tacos. Great flavors!!

This place is really fun. I take people here typically when they've never been to Idaho, because you know... potato's, French fries, it's all very idaho. Fries and fry sauces & seasonings are deelish! Burgers are kind of bland. I feel like they used to be better. The past 4 times we've gone, the burger patty is really dry, and thin. It's a little pricy for a decent burger and great fries and fun atmosphere. But... I'd still encourage someone to try it at least once. Maybe you'll love it!

Look no further during the week- this is your weekday morning breakfast spot once you try it once. The owner is exceptionally personable and can customise each entree if needed. 
The frittata are well seasoned and veggies well cooked. The omelette was also well seasoned. Didn't try the coffee but maybe on  one of my many return trips!!

This was our first stop in Nashville and we weren't disappointed! We got lucky with parking since there isn't much available, but there are a few spots behind the building that are free. The line was out the door when we got there around 3 pm, but it wasn't too long. Despite the short line, it still moved really slowly so I definitely wouldn't want to be here at the busier times. 
We tried the Damn Hot hot chicken sandwich and a chicken plate. The sides were just okay, nothing to write home about. The chicken is the real star here!! Both the chicken plate and the sandwich were super moist on the inside and crispy and flavorful on the outside. The Damn Hot is the second hottest flavor, but I found it to be not as hot as I expected. That being said, the flavor was great and if you love spicy food, you'll really enjoy it!

Very spotty. Order prefix menu. Citrus salad super sour. Pumpkin bisque luke warm. Duck with parsnips had very chewy duck. Parsnips and salad were great!  Shrimp and pasta great!  $9 for bread and butter was a lot but the butter was very tasty! Dessert ok. Meringue chewy. Very nice decor.

Who runs this place? Children? 
Cons They where out of donuts and tomatoes. Our waitress was over worked and had to explain she is bar and serving while I looked around and there where other servers playing (not working.) They do not keep things professional in the open area. 
I ordered the fish and chips. They tasted store bought. Fried pickles where burnt. 

Pros. Portion size is nice and fries are good. 

What needs work?? DONT STAND AROUND TALKING. As I am writing this 4 servers are standing talking and doing nothin else. I need my bill and have asked 3 times now. And running out of things?? Bad bad
I love there rolls, crispy veggies every time. Never disappointed, ask for extra eel sauce ! It's amazing here!!

This place deserves NEGATIVE STARS!!! 
I just moved here from the Chicago area.... this is the worst place I've ever been to! This is NOT Tacos - if you think it is, you haven't had real Tacos. Taco Bell is better than this! Not only that but 30+min wait on the crap food??!!! Sad part is, they weren't even slammed, busy yes NOT SLAMMED! People who ordered after us even got their food faster. No excuse for a "quick/fast food" establishment. 
Everything was cold, beans were a bowl of salt, taco shell was disgusting, sauce in their bottle was Louisiana sauce, rice was not even close to Uncle bens it was was gross, cheddar cheese on tacos??!!! I asked for cilantro, what did I get? PARSLEY - it's NOT the same thing! 
Bar service so pathetic! 3 bartenders, not a full bar to even take care of but took almost 10min for ONE BEER
What a waste of money! NOTHING can ever make me go back here ever again or suggest anyone to go there. 
DO NOT GO, this is NOT RECOMMENDED!!!

I think Olly is a great addition to the neighborhood. It was decorated beautifully, the food was great, our waitress was very friendly and it wasn't busy. I had read that Olly had just started doing brunch and wanted to give it a shot. I was mostly looking for new place to add to my breakfast/brunch rotation since most of the go-to places in town are always packed on Saturdays (cough Green Eggs cough). 

I walked in and was immediately surprised how great the decor was. It looked clean, classy and fairly upscale. We were immediately seated to no wait (it was early for brunch) at the corner window right at the front of the restaurant. I ordered a very simple order, which was eggs scrapple a biscuit and some coffee. The coffee was outstanding and the eggs and scrapple were cooking perfectly. Which is not terribly difficult but nothing bothers me more than when a restaurant messes up scrapple. I will say that I lived in the south for a number of years and have been searching all over philly for a decent biscuit. This place has great biscuits. Probably the best biscuit I've had since leaving South Carolina. So for breakfast foods, this place checks all the boxes for me.

For my significant other, she ordered the charred broccoli caesar, which she absolutely loved. I'm not one to order salad as a main when going out to eat, however I tried part of her dish and it really was amazing. The char on the vegetables, with varying textures perfectly balanced by the very unique "caesar" dr
Well I kissed and made up with Melba's and Scott Wolfe .... Another fine meal and I hope we have many more together !
Closest thing to a Southern California taco shop that I have found since moving to Indiana 5 years ago.

The food wasn't bad, the service wasn't all that great. It took an hour and a half to get our food. There was only 3 other tables in the same dining room as us. The waiter didn't check on us very much and then at one point while we were finishing eating came up and said " We've only got about 10 minutes left so do you guys need anything?" Still not sure what he meant by that, like maybe his shift was over?
Food is horrible. Service was extremely slow and the owner is a racist. I wouldn't let my dog  eat here. Of I could give no stars I would.

Wouldn't recommend. I tried placing a ubereats order at 10:15. Waited for it to be fullfilled and it was canceled due to the full slab being out of stock? Called the location the said no we have plenty, try grub hub. So I ordered at 10:30 from grubhub. Got several updates when the order would be delivered and who would be bringing it. So at 12:07 I call the location again because we never received our order. Get 3 people on the phone and all the sudden they say they just got the order and I get a message that the order was canceled. All I get is a sorry. Horrible customer service and not reliable!

I really hate to do this. I understand the pressure people can be under in fast foods but I just experienced the worst customer service that I believe I've ever experienced in my whole life at this place. I was coming back from ice skating in St Louis with my family including grandchildren and we were treated very rudely by the manager. They got our order wrong. I think he was saying that he was combining six fries into three fries but when we drove off and checked our meal we will give him the benefit of the doubt he didn't have containers for the fries but he was also missing a chicken sandwich and a cheeseburger. so we patiently went through the drive-thru again and presented what was missing to the manager. he basically said I'm the manager and I don't make mistakes and let me see the receipt and he acknowledged he remembered that we had just been through there and we told him the amount because just like another person mentioned that he does not tell you in the Drive-Thru but when you get up to the window that's when he tells you you must have either debit card or exact change. At first he was going to give our sandwiches back to us, but when my grandson who was driving asked if we could have his name slammed the windows shut after saying call this number and complain about me and now you don't even get your chicken sandwich. Did I mention that he never gav

In Riva is worth it for the ambience alone. There is an excellent patio with outdoor seating and plenty of heat lamps. I came on a Sunday after a walk at the nearby Wissahickon. We were seated promptly and tables were appropriately spaced. I was not in the mood to drink, but bottomless cocktails and/or mimosas are $25 (!!!) on weekends from 12-3. 

I opted for the cipolla pizza which was good but lacking flavor. It definitely could have used more balsamic. However, the crust was excellent. I then opted for dessert which was the star of the meal. I especially loved the chocolate budino which was a combination or raspberry and chocolate. I could have eaten 3 more although it was incredibly rich. 

Overall, the setting is lovely and great care was taken to ensure a safe dining experience.

I've passed by this place a hundred times and decided to try it recently, as they were one of the few restaurants in the local area doing takeout until 10pm. I ordered the Shrimp Curry and it was a bit disappointing. It lacked flavor and was supposed to be on a bed of forbidden rice - instead it came over overcooked white rice. The meat in the steak sandwich was incredibly tough and hard to eat. The one highlight of the meal with the truffle fries - delicious.

Love love pad Thai here it's so delicious. The noodle the sauce are mixed real well. Not to sweet. Presentation it's great I love bean fresh sprouts with it when mix together it's just perfect texture. They very busy but the service still very fast. And inside is very clean.  They don't open sitting yet which understand from the situation of COVID. Wish they all stay safe and keep serving us good clean food. Thank you.
How and why is this place still open. Have gone here 4 times now and not even been able to order food. Super dumb
For me, these were the best oysters I've ever eaten!! Chargrilled and raw. My first stop when I return to the Big Easy!!!
Certainly not the best Chinese food we've ever had. Sweet and sour chicken was definitely not what we expected (no tempura batter) and potstickers were flavorless.

We're in the middle of a pandemic and many local businesses (as well as some national ones) are endangered species, especially some of my favorite restaurants.  So I make a point of participating in Takeout Tuesday or takeout on another night at least once a week.   I spread the love (and money) among mom & pop places, high end spots and even the occasional chain.  I was very excited about my choice for this week:  On Swann.  I love On Swann as well as some of its sister restaurants.  

Unfortunately taking out is not the same as eating there.  The takeout menu is limited (but many of the favorites are there).  I love that it offers family size meals.  I ordered my beloved Kale Salad ($12) and the family-size chicken tenders with pomme frittes ($24) for the kiddos.  On Swann graciously included sides of its yummy "paprika honey" and "romesco" sauces to dress up those tenders as well as ketchup for the pomme frites.  If you have eaten at OS, you know how good those pomme frites can be.

The curbside pick-up took place behind the restaurant.  I was a bit confused but that was totally operator-error on my part.  The food was quickly placed in the car and I headed home.

The tenders were fantastic.  Finger-sized pieces of freshly fried chicken; they were moist on the inside and crispy on the outside.  My girls loved them and so did I, especially dipped in one of the sauces.  The romesco is my favorite.  The girls wanted the honey paprika all to themselves.

The pomme frittes were

I want to love this place more but it falls short.

The desserts are good but over priced for the product. If I am going to pay $10 for a waffle with toppings I want the waffle to be fresh not reheated. Reheating cause the waffle to be very chewy and hard to cut. The affogatto was good and I would get again if craving it. 

The ice cream is okay but I was expecting it to be better because it is made in house. Like everyone else said the customer service is lacking but its high school kids. I dont expected exceptional.

Other than the  the obnoxious saying " If you want spicy make spicy yourself" the food is amazing .You have ask in advance for the best if the best House Zooey's Fun" That damn dish brought the house down ! The family that owns it are done if the kindest humans I have met in friendly Reno
Stop by the sex shop next door if you have another appetite you want to satisfyJust a thought
Big hugs, Beefy's

By far the worst experience. If this night time worker does not get fired I will never be back.  She has disrespected and deceived many customers.  I'm sure she ended up taking home our order and giving us a made up pre made crap that is tossed at the end of the night. Corporate or franchise owner should do their due diligence and look into this matter.  She even charged us more !

Went in for a beach drink to take to our balcony for sunset watching. There are no liquor stores near us, so asked if I could purchase a bottle of wine. No problem. He even offered to open it and give me plastic glasses, but that was taken care of in our little apartment. I've been back for more drinks, but we haven't eaten there yet. Maybe tomorrow (or Sunday)!  Very friendly greeters and bartender.

This is the cutest, best brunch place I've ever been to! Service was quick, staff was so friendly, and the food/drinks were awesome. The inside is so nice too, bright and happy colors all around with a homey atmosphere. I can't wait to go back!!
The calzone was tasteless and the meat fillings sparse. Perhaps I should have ordered a platter. On a positive note the staff is friendly and it is a clean and pleasant atmosphere.
Nice neighborhood bar. Good food great service. Got to try Crab cake good stuff. House salad dressing excellent.

I wanted to give a five star review for this restaurant, given that I've eaten here before and loved it. However, this time the experience was of much lower quality. I hope it is just because of the added stress and changes of the pandemic. The online site to order from is difficult to navigate. I had to try a few times in order to get it right. Employees were wearing a mask, which is excellent. The new location is alright, however the old location and the courtyard were so charming that this is a strange change.
We ordered the endless summer scramble, two orders of the two eggs and the smoked salmon bagel. There was nothing standout about any of the food. The scramble was oily and some of the fried items were soggy. The two eggs orders were fine but not worth the price tag. The bagel and salmon were also fine but definitely not worth $20. We are disappointed because we normally love Scarlet Begonia, and we wanted to leave a positive review. However, this experience was just not up to par and that was a shame.
